title: Stepwise in vitro induction of human somitic mesoderm and its derivatives
protocol: Coat cell culture dishes with laminin.
Culture human iPSCs on the coated dishes using StemFit® AK02N medium.
Maintain high-quality human iPSC cultures for subsequent differentiation steps.
Add 1.5 ml of PBS containing iMatrix-511 silk (0.5 µg/cm²) into each well of a 6 well sterile culture plate.
Incubate the plate with coating agent either for >1 hour at 37°C, for >3 hours at room temperature or overnight at 4°C.
Add 750 μl of StemFit®AK02N and mix thoroughly.
Aspirate the medium and add 1.5 ml of StemFit®AK02N containing Y-27632 (10 µM).
Place plate into humidified CO₂ incubator at 37°C.
Prepare ~80% confluent culture of human feeder-free iPSCs.
Aspirate the culture medium.
Wash the iPS cell colonies with PBS.
Add 300 μl of 0.5x TrypLE™ Select enzyme solution
Incubate the plate in a humidified CO₂ incubator at 37°C.
Take out the plate after 1 minute and re-distribute TrypLE™ Select enzyme solution, then return it to the incubator for another 3 minutes.
Observe cells under the microscope; if not detached, incubate for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Aspirate the solution and wash the cells gently with PBS.
Aspirate PBS and add 1 ml of StemFit®AK02N with Y-27632 (10 µM).
Harvest cells using a cell scraper into a 1.5 ml microtube.
Dissociate collected cells by pipetting up and down approximately 10 times.
Measure the cell density.
Seed 1.3x10⁴ cells per well onto iMatrix-511 silk-coated 6-well culture plates containing pre-warmed medium.
Distribute cells evenly across the plate by gentle shaking.
Incubate the plate with cells in a humidified CO₂ incubator at 37°C.
Change the medium to StemFit®AK02N without Y-27632 on the following day.
Change medium every other day, or daily if it turns yellow or iPSCs start differentiating.
Passage once every week.
Transfer the required number of cells from culture plate or dish into a 1.5 ml microtube and centrifuge at 800 rpm for 5 minutes at 22°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cells in Stem-cellbanker (Takara) at 1.0x10^6 cells/ml.
Add 200 µl of cell suspension containing 2.0x10^5 cells into a cryogenic tube.
Freeze vials in pre-cooled freezing container at -80°C for overnight.
Transfer frozen vials into a liquid nitrogen tank the next day.
Set water bath to 37°C.
Add 5 ml of StemFit®AK02N with Y-27632 (10 µM) into a 15 ml tube.
Thaw a frozen vial of iPSCs in the water bath until only a few small ice particles remain.
Transfer cells into a 15 ml tube.
Centrifuge at 800 rpm, 22°C for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Add 500 μl of StemFit®AK02N with Y-27632 to the cells.
Dissociate the cells gently by pipetting about 10 times.
Measure the cell density using a hemocytometer or automated cell counter.
Seed 1.3x10^4 single cells per well onto laminin-coated 6-well culture plates.
Ensure that the viability of the cells is high before seeding.
Perform all described steps under a clean-bench.
Use sterile tips and bottles.
Dissolve bovine serum albumin (BSA) at 10 mg/ml in Ham’s F-12 Nutrient Mix (F12).
Add Penicillin-Streptomycin (P/S) at 100 unit/100 µg/ml to the BSA-F12 solution.
Pass dissolved mixture through a filter bottle with a pore size of 0.22 µm.
Mix filtered BSA and P/S containing F12 medium with IMDM in a 1:1 ratio.
Add sterile reconstituted Apo-transferrin at 15 µg/ml to the mixed medium.
Add 1-Thioglycerol at 450 µM to the medium.
Add CD Lipid at 1% to the medium.
Add rh-Insulin at 7 µg/ml to the medium.
Store the prepared Chemically Defined Medium (CDM) at 4°C until use.
Prepare PS induction medium by adding CHIR99021 (10 µM), rh-Activin A (50 ng/ml), and rh-bFGF (20 ng/ml) to CDM.
Culture iPSCs in humidified CO₂ incubator on laminin-coated plates for 5 days after initial seeding at single cell level.
Check colonies of iPSCs under microscope before induction; do not proceed if conditions are poor.
Aspirate the maintenance medium (StemFit® AK02N) from each well.
Add 2 ml of PS induction medium into each well.
Culture iPSCs in PS induction medium at 37°C for 24 hours in humidified CO₂ incubator.
Aspirate previous induction medium from cells.
Add 2 ml of freshly made PSM induction medium containing CHIR99021 (3 µM), LDN193189 (250 nM), rh-bFGF (20 ng/ml) and SB431542 (10 µM).
Culture cells in a humidified CO₂ incubator at 37°C for 24 hours.

Use induced PSM cells for subsequent differentiation into human somitic mesoderm (SM) cells or analysis of in vitro features of induced PSM cells, including oscillatory expression of segmentation clock genes.
Cultivate luciferase-reporter line of human HES7 in CDM-based PSM medium containing D-luciferin.
Measure bioluminescent activity using a luminometer set-up for extended culture of PSM cells in vitro.
Adjust the level of WNT activity during in vitro culture as required for other human and non-human pluripotent stem cells.
Prepare SM induction medium by adding PD173074 (100 nM) and XAV939 (1 µM) to CDM.
Aspirate previous PSM induction medium.
Add 2 ml of freshly made SM induction medium.
Culture cells in humidified CO₂ incubator at 37°C for 24 hours.
Use induced SM cells for subsequent differentiation into human sclerotome (SCL) or dermomyotome (DM) cells.
Utilize SM cells for further characterization and quality control, including RNA and protein isolation, immunocytochemistry, FACS, and quantitative PCR (qRT-PCR).
Prepare DM induction medium by adding CHIR99021 (3 µM), GDC-0449 (150 nM) and rh-BMP4 (50 ng/ml) to CDM.
Aspirate previous SM induction medium.
Add 2 ml of freshly made DM induction medium.
Culture cells in humidified CO₂ incubator at 37°C for 48 hours.
Aspirate previous (SM) induction medium.
Add 2 ml of freshly made SCL induction medium.
Culture cells in humidified CO2 incubator at 37°C for 72 hours.
Dilute Matrigel® with DMEM at a ratio of 1:50.
Add 500 μl of the Matrigel® solution to each well in a 12-well sterile culture plate.
Incubate for >1 hour at 37°C, for >3 hours at room temperature, or overnight at 4°C.
Aspirate the coating solution and add 1 ml of skeletal muscle induction medium pre-warmed in an incubator prior to use.
Wash DM cells with PBS.
Add 1 ml of Accutase® and distribute it evenly across the cells.
Incubate for 2 minutes.
Take out the plate, re-distribute the Accutase®, and incubate for another 2 minutes.
Observe the cells under a microscope to check if they are starting to detach; if not, incubate for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Add 4 ml of induction medium with Y-27632 (10 µM) for neutralization.
Harvest cells with cell scraper into a 15 ml tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 800 rpm, 22°C for 4 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant and add 3 ml of induction medium containing Y-27632 (10 µM).
Dissociate cells gently by pipetting and measure cell concentration.
Seed 2.5x10^5 DM cells per well onto Matrigel® coated 12-well culture plate.
Change to induction medium without Y-27632 on the next day.
Culture cells in a humidified CO₂ incubator at 37°C for 3 weeks.
Change skeletal muscle induction medium every 3 days.
Monitor spontaneously contracting colonies of induced human skeletal muscle cells which will appear within two weeks of culture.
Wash the SCL cells with PBS.
Add 1 ml of Accutase™ and distribute it evenly.
Incubate for 2 minutes.
Take out the plate, re-distribute the Accutase™ and incubate for another 2 minutes.
Observe the cells under the microscope whether they are detached or not; if not, incubate for another 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Add 4 ml of CDM with Y-27632 (10 µM) for neutralization.
Harvest cells with cell scraper into a 15 ml tube and centrifuge at 800 rpm, 22°C, for 4 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Add 3 ml of SCL induction medium with Y-27632 (10 µM).
Dissociate the cells gently by pipetting.
Measure cell concentration.
Prepare a cell suspension at a concentration of 2.0x10^6 cells/ml in SCL induction medium with Y-27632 (10 µM).
Transfer 100 μl/well of the cell suspension containing 2.0x10^5 cells into a 96 well low attachment plate.
Incubate for overnight to form 3D-SCL spheres.
Take out 3D-SCL spheres and transfer them into a 35 mm dish.
Wash the spheres with base medium twice.
Add supplemental growth factors just before use.
Add 7 to 10 ml of 3D-CI medium into the low attachment dish (Sumitomo Bakelite).
Distribute all spheres evenly to prevent fusion.
Change the medium every 3 days.
Culture 3D-SCL spheres in a humidified CO2 incubator at 37°C for 30 days or longer as required by the experimental schedule.
Prepare SCL cell suspension (5.0x10^5-1.2x10^6 cells/100 µl) in SCL induction medium with Y-27632 (10 µM).
Mix 100 µl of cell suspension with the same amount of Matrigel®.
Inject mixture of cells and Matrigel® into NOD/ShiJic-scidJcl mice subcutaneously using a 1ml syringe with a 26 G needle.
Evaluate after two months the formation of hard cartilage/bone tissue from transplanted human sclerotome cells in recipient mice.
Make an incision into the back of NOD/ShiJic-scid Jcl mice.
Transplant ~20-30 of in vitro induced human 3D cartilage.
Suture the incision after transplantation.
Evaluate formation of endochondral bone from transplanted 3D cartilage two months post-transplantation.
Aspirate induction or maintenance medium from samples.
Wash samples with PBS (1 ml).
Immerse samples in 2% PFA for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate added PFA and wash samples twice with PBS (1 ml).
Incubate samples in 0.2% Triton™ X-100 in PBS for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Wash samples with PBST (1% TWEEN®20 in PBS).
Block samples in 5% skim milk in distilled water (DW) for 1 hour at room temperature.
Aspirate the blocking solution.
Stain samples with primary antibodies diluted in 10% of blocking solution (5% skim milk in DW) for overnight at 4°C.
Aspirate the primary antibodies and wash the samples with PBST three times.
Stain samples with secondary antibodies for 1 hour at room temperature.
Aspirate the secondary antibodies and wash the samples with PBST twice.
Stain samples with DAPI (2 µg/ml) for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Wash the samples with PBST.
Store the samples at 4°C shaded from light until microscopic evaluation.
Aspirate the medium.
Wash the cells with PBS.
Add Accutase™ and incubate for 4 minutes at 37°C.
Neutralize the cells with CDM containing Y-27632 (10 µM) and collect with a cell scraper.
Measure the concentration of the cell suspension and centrifuge at 800 rpm for 4 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in FACS buffer (0.1% BSA in PBS) containing Y-27632 (10 µM) at a concentration of 1.0x10^7 cells/ml.
Stain the cells with primary antibody or conjugated antibody (or isotype control) for 30 minutes at 4°C protected from light.
Wash the cells with PBS and centrifuge at 800 rpm for 4 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in FACS buffer containing Y-27632 (10 µM) at a concentration of 5.0x10^6 cells/ml and stain with DAPI (500 ng/ml).
Filtrate the cells through a fine mesh.
Analyze with a cell analyzer.

In case of co-staining intracellular molecules, fix the cells with 4% PFA for 20 minutes at 4°C after initial staining of surface markers. Permeabilize and stain fixed cells with primary antibodies against intracellular molecules of interest.
Add 2-Mercaptoethanol (2-ME) to RLT Buffer (10 µl 2-ME/ml RLT Buffer).
Aspirate culture medium and wash the cells with PBS (2 ml).
Aspirate the PBS and add 350 μl of RLT Buffer + 2-ME.
Collect the cells with scraper into a 1.5 ml microtube.
Mix the sample thoroughly by vortexing (30 seconds).
Store the sample until isolation of RNA at -30°C.
Isolate RNA with RNeasy Mini kit or other RNA isolation kit.
RNA can be used for cDNA generation and qRT-PCR or library preparation and RNA-sequencing analysis.
